raw_segments.text: Pa was inside it and Ma crying in the parlor and Uncle Barney telling the men how to get
it round the bend. A big coffin it was, and high and heavy looking. How was that? The
last night Pa was boost he was standing on the landing there bawling out for his boots
to go out to Tunnies for to boost more and he looked buddy and short in his shirt. Never
see him again. Death, that is. Pa is dead. My father is dead. He told me to be a good
I couldn't hear the other things he said, but I saw his tongue and his teeth trying
to say it better. Poor Pa. That was Mr. Dignum, my father. I hope he's in purgatory now
because he went to confession to Father Conroy on Saturday night.
